The structure of K4Mg2Sb4O12 (K2Mg(SbO3)2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 22 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg centers coordinated by six O neighbors and K centers with four O neighbors, while Sb centers adopt a tetrahedral environment with four O neighbors. Corner-sharing between Sb tetrahedra is observed, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 22 sites.
